normalizationRules: Represent paths as UTF-8 POSIX paths with no leading ./.
Treat / as the root publication base and /ediciones/YYYY as an archive base.
Strip exactly one configured publication-base prefix before comparing normalized output paths.
Reject absolute paths, drive-qualified paths, NUL bytes, backslash traversal, .. segments, symlink escapes, and non-regular files.
Hash exact file bytes with SHA-256; exclude timestamps, host separators, and enumeration order.
Sort manifest entries by normalized path and use owner ID only as a diagnostic tie-breaker.
Reserve 404.html, robots.txt, sitemap files, and evidence files for the distribution owner.
Compare semantics and ownership rather than literal generated _astro hash filenames; normalize generated CSS references before comparing page HTML.
Record browser, HTTP status, visual, interaction, and command results as unobserved when verification cannot obtain them; this baseline records Chromium headless and dev-server status evidence.
rollback: Remove this evidence file and workspace metadata; the unchanged root application remains the deployable source.
